findings.title: Required delivery evidence remains pending
findings.rationale: E74 strongly supports the disposable PostgreSQL/BFF/browser candidate, but it does not prove DOD-11 through DOD-13. The package expressly lacks preserved-runtime activation and migration proof, operator-assisted first sends and replies, applied module consolidation, the authorized canonical full diff guard, and final delivery review. This is not a test-only defect or a reason to weaken the current suite; it is a release-blocking operational gap. Options: A) complete the bounded gates with their required approvals and source/runtime attestations; B) formally defer delivery while retaining the candidate; C) do nothing, which safely leaves the capability undelivered.
findings.suggested_action: Choose A before any delivery claim: obtain the specific runtime/private-boundary authority where required, execute the approved local/operator proof without automated contacts, apply and review canonical module consolidation, run the authorized full guard, and complete final assurance. Until then retain the TODO as pending; recommendation: A.
